And.description: Associations which are all needed at once: the subunits of a complex.
And.title: And

AssignmentRule.description: An assignment rule of a variable.
AssignmentRule.title: AssignmentRule

CVTerm.description:
An annotation: a qualifier (BQB or BQM of pymetadata) with its resources.

A term can carry terms of its own, which qualify it further: the evidence
for a relation or the modification of a protein (core §6).
CVTerm.title: CVTerm

CompSBase.description: The comp extension of an element.
CompSBase.title: CompSBase

ConversionFactor.description: The conversion factor parameter of a model or species.
ConversionFactor.title: ConversionFactor

Creator.description: A creator of the model history.
Creator.title: Creator

Delay.description: The delay of an event: the time between the trigger and the execution.
Delay.title: Delay

Deletion.description: An element of a submodel which is removed before it is instantiated.
Deletion.title: Deletion

Edge.description:
A directed reference from one object to another.

Edges are immutable values, so that they can be used in sets and as keys.
Edge.title: Edge

EdgeKind.description: The kinds of references between objects.
EdgeKind.title: EdgeKind

Event.description: An event with trigger, priority, delay and assignments.
Event.title: Event

EventAssignment.description: An assignment executed by an event.
EventAssignment.title: EventAssignment

ExternalModelDefinition.description: A comp reference to a model in another document.
ExternalModelDefinition.title: ExternalModelDefinition

FluxBound.description:
A bound of the flux of a reaction, the constraint of fbc Version 1.

Version 2 replaced it by the `lowerFluxBound` and `upperFluxBound`
attributes of a reaction, which name a parameter instead of holding a
value, so a bound of a Version 1 document is an element of the report and
of no later one.
FluxBound.title: FluxBound

FluxObjective.description: One term of an objective: a reaction weighted by a coefficient.
FluxObjective.title: FluxObjective

FunctionDefinition.description: A function definition with its lambda.
FunctionDefinition.title: FunctionDefinition

GeneProductAssociation.description: The genes under which a reaction can run, as the tree of fbc §3.9.
GeneProductAssociation.title: GeneProductAssociation

GeneProductRef.description: A leaf of a gene product association: the gene product it names.
GeneProductRef.title: GeneProductRef

InitialAssignment.description: An initial assignment of a symbol.
InitialAssignment.title: InitialAssignment

KeyValuePair.description:
One entry of the controlled annotation of fbc Version 3 (fbc §3.17).

A key value pair carries metadata which no attribute of SBML holds, and
libsbml reads it from the annotation of any element. It is a nested object
of that element and not an element of the report: nothing references it, it
references nothing, and libsbml does not read the identifier and the name
the specification allows it back from a file.
KeyValuePair.title: KeyValuePair

KineticLaw.description: The kinetic law of a reaction.
KineticLaw.title: KineticLaw

LinkGraph.description: All objects of a report and the references between them.
LinkGraph.title: LinkGraph

LocalParameter.description: A local parameter of a kinetic law.
LocalParameter.title: LocalParameter

Manifest.description: The manifest of a COMBINE archive.
Manifest.title: Manifest

ManifestEntry.description: An entry of the manifest of a COMBINE archive.
ManifestEntry.title: ManifestEntry

Math.description: The math of an element as latex and as L3 formula string.
Math.title: Math

Model.description:
A model or comp model definition with the lists of its elements.

`annotation_xml` takes the place of the `xml` of every other element, which
is not part of the report for the document and the model because it is the
whole file.
Model.title: Model

ModelFbc.description:
The fbc extension of a model.

`strict` exists from Version 2 on and `active_objective` is the attribute
of the `listOfObjectives`, which the report does not carry as an object of
its own (fbc §3.3, §3.3.1).
ModelFbc.title: ModelFbc

ModelHistory.description: The history of an element: creators and dates.
ModelHistory.title: ModelHistory

Node.description:
A node of the link graph: one SBML object.

Nodes are immutable values, so that they can be used in sets and as keys.
Node.title: Node

Or.description: Associations of which one suffices: the isozymes of a reaction.
Or.title: Or

Package.description: An SBML package used by the document.
Package.title: Package

Port.description: A comp port referencing an element of the model.
Port.title: Port

Priority.description: The priority of an event: the order of the events of one moment.
Priority.title: Priority

RateRule.description: A rate rule of a variable.
RateRule.title: RateRule

Reaction.description:
A reaction with its participants and kinetic law.

`equation` is the readable equation, its half equations joined by a plain
unicode arrow: "⇆" (U+21C6) for a reversible reaction, "➞" (U+279E)
otherwise.
Reaction.title: Reaction

ReactionFbc.description: The fbc extension of a reaction.
ReactionFbc.title: ReactionFbc

ReplacedBy.description: The element of a submodel which replaces this element.
ReplacedBy.title: ReplacedBy

ReplacedElement.description: An element of a submodel which this element replaces.
ReplacedElement.title: ReplacedElement

Report.description: The report of one SBML document.
Report.title: Report

ReportEntry.description: The report of one SBML entry of an archive.
ReportEntry.title: ReportEntry

SBMLDocument.description:
The document: level, version and the packages it uses.

`annotation_xml` takes the place of the `xml` of every other element, which
is not part of the report for the document and the model because it is the
whole file.
SBMLDocument.title: SBMLDocument

SBaseRef.description:
A link of a reference chain, which names an element of a submodel.

The chain starts at a port, a deletion, a replaced element or a replaced
by, whose reference names a submodel; every further link names an element
of the model that submodel instantiates (comp §3.7.2).
SBaseRef.title: SBaseRef

SpeciesFbc.description:
The fbc extension of a species.

The charge is a double, which is what fbc Version 3 made of the integer of
the versions before it (fbc §3.4).
SpeciesFbc.title: SpeciesFbc

SpeciesReference.description: A reactant or product of a reaction.
SpeciesReference.title: SpeciesReference

Submodel.description: A comp submodel instantiating a model definition.
Submodel.title: Submodel

Trigger.description: The trigger of an event: the condition which fires it.
Trigger.title: Trigger

UncertParameter.description: A parameter of a distrib uncertainty.
UncertParameter.title: UncertParameter

Uncertainty.description: A distrib uncertainty of an element.
Uncertainty.title: Uncertainty

Unit.description:
One factor of a unit definition: a base unit with exponent, scale and multiplier.

A unit carries no identifier and nothing in SBML refers to it, so it is a
nested object of its definition and not an element of the report with a
primary key of its own.
Unit.title: Unit

UnitDefinition.description: A unit definition with its units and their rendered formula.
UnitDefinition.title: UnitDefinition

UserDefinedConstraint.description: A constraint of fbc Version 3 over a combination of model variables.
UserDefinedConstraint.title: UserDefinedConstraint

UserDefinedConstraintComponent.description: One term of a user defined constraint (fbc §3.15).
UserDefinedConstraintComponent.title: UserDefinedConstraintComponent

description: The response of the api: the manifest and one report per SBML entry.
title: ReportResponse
